answer: Reputation-weighted escrow with delayed settlement. Each new identity must escrow a fixed fee for 30 days, and payouts decay with registration age; a clone earns almost nothing before expiry. Any whisper of shared funding or behavior clusters flags linked accounts, freezing their escrow. An honest user loses only float on the fee; a sybil farm loses the full fee per clone plus a ripple of clawbacks across accounts, making each marginal copy strictly negative-EV. The operator also forfeits accumulated timber, since frozen balances never settle.
